opening: I am a very smart student who always pass tests and exams with flying colors. I failed the course. Why?
answer: The course has a group project which contributes significantly towards the final grades. Unfortunately, everyone in the group except me is a free rider. Due to the huge workload, I completed the project poorly, received a poor grade and thus failed the course.
